author: Karebear420
quote: So many years waiting.... and THIS is what they come up with. I have to be honest, I am hugely disappointed. Gta is a blow off valve for many people. A way to blow off steam and take a little break from the real world. Now you gotta paint the house, get groceries, shop for a present... come on. The entire point of playing gta is the extreme craziness and lack of consequences. Whether it's picking up a sex worker (which is a corner stone of gta btw) or taking a stranger to the "murder spot" or chillin at the strip club, it's all about doing things you would never do in real life. I was excited for gta 6 until I started to see people's videos and reviews. So glad I didnt spend 100 bucks on what is basically the Sims meet modern Red Dead. People playing gta are looking for murder, mayhem and cool cars. Shouldn't even be allowed to call this trash game GTA. It's really grand theft errands : the live, laugh, love edition
